title.narrative: (Oc 2) Improved mutual understanding and cooperation between the business sector and CSOs in Vietnam in implementing CSR and CSV initiatives related to the selected SDGs by establishing an effective cooperation mechanism.

description.narrative: (Oc 2) Improved mutual understanding and cooperation between the business sector and CSOs in Vietnam in implementing CSR and CSV initiatives related to the selected SDGs by establishing an effective cooperation mechanism.

title.narrative: (Oc 2.1) Cooperation mechanism to improve mutual understanding and cooperation between the business sector and CSOs in Vietnam with the goal of implementing CSR and CSV actions related to the SDGs is established, works effectively and maintains.

description.narrative: (Oc 2.1) Cooperation mechanism to improve mutual understanding and cooperation between the business sector and CSOs in Vietnam with the goal of implementing CSR and CSV actions related to the SDGs is established, works effectively and maintains.

comment.narrative: Oc 2.1 A cooperation mechanism to improve mutual understanding between the business sector and CSOs in Vietnam with the goal of implementing CSR and CSV actions related to the SDGs is established works effectively and maintains.

Over the span of 4 years implementing the project 29 main activities have been organized with active participation from 690 individuals from CSOs and 1241 participants from businesses. The project has utilised a rich and diverse array of intervention formats training sessions conferences CSV talks Cafonline webinars subgrant projects with financial andor technical assistance the Carbon Credit competition Networking galas M4D Awards etc. to create effective networking spaces for both CSOs and businesses. These activities have provided opportunities for both CSOs and businesses to raise awareness about the Sustainable Development Goals SDGs understand businesses CSRCSV programmes and gain a clearer understanding of each others roles and positions in society. Additionally these initiatives have highlighted the opportunities and effectiveness of cooperation between businesses and CSOs in implementing CSRCSV programmes for sustainability. Effective collaboration between the two parties contributes to the progress of achieving national SDGs of Vietnam.

description.narrative: (Oc 2.2) RED become a HUB facilitating business and CSOs initiatives focusing on SDGs.

comment.narrative: Oc 2.2 RED become a trust worthy and reliable HUB facilitating business and CSOs initiatives focusing on SDGs in Vietnam

RED has utilized the CSVhub platform as an effective communication tool to connect businesses and CSOs. RED has organized a series of CSV talks webinars training sessions conferences information on subgrant packages the Marketing for Development M4D Award and regularly shared information on CSVhubs communication channels Facebook Page Facebook Group Zalo Group etc..The content of training courses webinars and online caf sessions with CSOs were recorded and uploaded to CSVhubs YouTube channel serving as a knowledge database that will continue to exist after the projects conclusion.Currently RED continues to collaborate with Marcom associationsclubs to maintain and develop the M4D Award while utilising the CSRCSV network effectively. In the future RED aims to remain as a hub supporting collaborative initiatives between businesses and civil social organizations CSOs in practicing CSRCSV in the new context of ESG.As a member of VECOM VNHR VBCSD and Euro Cham RED will continue to act as a bridge between businesses and CSOs to implement development programmes aiming at achieving the SDGs in Vietnam
